item.title: Sparta man gets life for murdering his father in 2023
item.description: Chantry Dean Hale, 47, of Sparta, Missouri, was sentenced to life in prison without parole for first-degree murder and an additional 30 years for armed criminal action after being found guilty of murdering his father, Jimmy Hale, in August 2023.

item.title: Branson PD Chief discusses ICE agreement; latest LEA to have 287g contract
item.description: Branson Police Chief Eric Schmitt has discussed the 287g agreement with ICE, which allows Branson PD to arrest individuals unlawfully in the country, but only if they are causing public safety issues and with the approval of a supervisor.
